# Queue History

**Phase:** Task 21 — Queue History  
**Project:** EasyCheck Online

## Collection: queue_history

**Document ID:** Auto-generated by Firestore

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| clinicId | string | Yes | Associated clinic |
| sessionDate | string | Yes | Session date |
| previousNumber | integer | Yes | Number before change |
| newNumber | integer | Yes | Number after change |
| action | string | Yes | 'increment', 'reset', 'correction' |
| performedBy | string | Yes | UID of staff member |
| timestamp | timestamp | Yes | Operation time |

## Immutability

- History entries cannot be updated or deleted by clients
- Security Rules enforce: allow update: if false, allow delete: if false
- Only system (via trusted backend) can create entries

## Audit Trail

Each parcha increment and daily reset creates a history entry with:
- Who performed the action (performedBy = auth.uid)
- When it happened (timestamp = server timestamp)
- What changed (previousNumber → newNumber)
- What type of action (action)
